name: ANSI/IEEE illuminated normally-open pushbutton symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for illuminated normally-open pushbutton, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The illuminated NO pushbutton form combines a manually operated contact and a lamp function in one operator assembly. The indication circuit needs its own supply and signal reference, because illumination does not necessarily track the contact position.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the lamp and switch circuits independently.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An illuminated button and a push-to-test lamp combine different operator and indication functions.
